description: This file defines functions for creating and logging network cache disk cache log parameters, including data read/write, completion, sparse operations, and range results.

methods.name: NetLogReadWriteDataParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with parameters for a read/write data event, including index, offset, buffer length, and optional truncation flag.

methods.name: NetLogReadWriteCompleteParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary indicating the result of a read/write operation, either bytes copied or a network error.

methods.name: NetLogSparseOperationParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with parameters for a sparse operation, including offset and buffer length.

methods.name: NetLogSparseReadWriteParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary for sparse read/write events, including source information and child length.

methods.name: CreateNetLogParametersEntryCreationParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with key and creation status for a cache entry.

methods.name: NetLogReadWriteData
methods.description: Logs a data read/write event with specified parameters.

methods.name: NetLogReadWriteComplete
methods.description: Logs completion of a read/write operation with bytes copied or error.

methods.name: NetLogSparseReadWrite
methods.description: Logs a sparse read/write event with source info.

methods.name: CreateNetLogGetAvailableRangeResultParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary representing the result of a range query, including length and start or error.
